stats.title: Progress
stats.chartEmpty: The trend draws itself once there are weigh-ins from a few days.
stats.trendPending: rate appears once weigh-ins span two weeks
stats.tdeeTip: TDEE = Total Daily Energy Expenditure — what you actually burn in a day. Measured from your logged intake against the weight trend, not guessed from a formula.
stats.tdeePending: Opens when {required} of the last {days} full days are logged and the weight is on the books at both ends of the window.
stats.reason_new_phase_water_shift: a new phase — water shifts distort
stats.weeksEmpty: The ledger fills as days are logged.

goal.title: Goal phase
goal.closesOld: Opening a new phase closes this one the day before the new start — past days keep their old target.
goal.noPhase: No phase is open. Days are logged without a target until one starts.
goal.restNote: Unmarked days use the rest-day target; a training day is marked on the day sheet.
goal.phaseTargets: rest {kcalRest} kcal · {proteinRest} g — training {kcalTraining} kcal · {proteinTraining} g protein
goal.startsKeep: Starts — leave as is to keep

profile.title: Profile
profile.bodyNote: Optional. Used for energy arithmetic later; never judged.
profile.coachingPlaceholder: In your own words — your AI reads this with every summary.
profile.apiNoAnswer: The API did not answer. Try again.
profile.nicknameNote: Random on purpose — the app never sees your name or email, so the nickname is the only name an account has.
profile.exportNote: Everything you own as one zip file: CSV sheets for spreadsheets and machine-readable JSON. Your email address is not included — Annos never holds it.
profile.deleteWarning: Permanent and immediate: every log, weight, goal phase, template and own food is erased, the sign-in is removed, and connected AI clients lose access. No grace period. Deleted data lingers only in encrypted backups, which rotate out within 30 days.
profile.deleteConfirmFinal: Press again to delete — no way back
profile.deleteWrongPassword: Wrong password — the sign-in was not removed. Your Annos data is already erased; enter the correct password to finish.

welcome.title: One name, drawn for you
welcome.intro: Inside Annos you are a nickname, not an email. Roll until one feels right — it is permanent after this page.
welcome.drawFailedBody: The API did not answer. Try the dice again.
welcome.failedBody: The API did not answer. Try again.

auth.oauthNotice: An application is asking to access your Annos data. Sign in to continue.
auth.quarantine: Your email stays with the sign-in system — the tracker itself never sees it. Inside Annos you are only your nickname, drawn on the next page.
auth.checkEmailBody: We've sent a confirmation link to your email. Open it to finish creating your account and draw your nickname.
auth.notVerified: Confirm your email first. We sent a link when you signed up — open it, or resend below.
auth.forgotBody: Enter your email and we'll send a link to choose a new password.
auth.resetSent: If that address has an account, a reset link is on its way. Check your inbox.
auth.resetDone: Password updated. You can sign in now.
auth.resetInvalid: This reset link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
auth.agree: By continuing you agree to the <terms>Terms</terms> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

settings.title: Settings
settings.mcpIntro: Annos works inside your AI client over the Model Context Protocol: the same account, the same data, the tools acting as you. Anything you can do here, your AI can do in conversation.
settings.mcpConfigNote: For other MCP clients that take a JSON configuration.
settings.mcpStep1: Add the connector in Claude, or the configuration in another MCP client.
settings.mcpStep2: On first use it opens this app's sign-in — sign in with your Annos account and approve access.
settings.mcpStep3: The Annos tools appear in your client: logging, revising, day summaries — scoped to your data alone.
settings.aboutBody: Annos tracks food, exercise and weight. You can use it here or from an AI client connected over MCP; both work on the same data and can do the same things. It shows your day against your targets and gives no advice. Accounts are pseudonymous: a generated nickname is the only name inside the app. Annos is free and <repo>open source</repo>.
settings.tzNote: The timezone decides when your day rolls over — a 00:30 snack belongs to the new day.
settings.mcpClaudeNote: In Claude, add this as a custom connector: Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector.
